title: Local Citi Bike share calibration: published observations and denominator audit
headline: Local shares vary by place, year and day type. No current citywide multiplier is estimated.

methods.dcp_filter: Keep 2013–2015 records with a positive reported bicycle denominator; retain all six recorded zero Citi Bike counts.
methods.dcp_fraction: citibike_all / cyclistvolume (on-street), or citibike_all / cyclists_all (off-street). Never divide by all-user volume.
methods.dcp_window: Official dictionary states annual fall counts. Tables/dictionary do not expose exact observation dates or within-day start/end times; those fields remain null.
methods.zero_handling: Recorded Citi Bike zero is preserved as zero, not missing. It does not prove the probability of a Citi Bike crossing was exactly zero and cannot produce a finite inverse-share calibration.
methods.non_integer_counts: Preserve fractional source values. Do not coerce the 1802.5 bicycle count to an integer or invent an averaging explanation.
methods.aggregation: No pooled citywide share or average of different windows. Range summaries describe observed local records only.
methods.uncertainty: No binomial confidence intervals: sampling windows/design and dependence are insufficiently documented; these records are not a probability sample of NYC trips.

issues.action: Retain reported cyclist denominator and flag; do not silently repair.
Retain published values; all users is not used as bicycle-share denominator.

nyu.reason: Methods mention separate electric/pedal Citi Bike observations, but published Appendix C device tables do not expose those separate categories or define a mapping from Other bike to Citi Bike.
nyu.method_locator: Figure 3, PDF page 23 (printed page 12); Appendix C introduction, PDF page 83 (printed C-1)
nyu.allowed_use: Use published classified micromobility volumes with explicit bicycle/all-micromobility denominators; do not call Other bike a Citi Bike count.
nyu.missing_data_needed: Underlying categorized observations or explicit author-confirmed mapping for the collapsed published categories.

extraction_audit.critical_finding: The methods and Figure 3 distinguish Citi Bike electric/pedal, but the released Appendix C tables publish only six categories and no explicit Citi Bike count. Other bike cannot be assumed to mean Citi Bike.
extraction_audit.extraction: pypdf text extraction; strict eight-integer device-row parsing; table/location metadata and column order verified from rendered PDF pages. No numeric transcription or category relabeling.
extraction_audit.denominator_definition: Published bicycle-labeled count = Personal E-bike + Rental E-bike + Pedal bike + Other bike. All micromobility adds Moped and Scooter. This denominator is computable; Citi Bike numerator is unpublished in these tables.
extraction_audit.delivery_status_note: Others includes uncertain delivery-worker status; do not label it exclusively non-delivery.
extraction_audit.screenline_note: Five sites yield eight detailed directional tables. C-1 combines 11th/44th NB and SB; detailed C-7 and C-8 keep them separate. No sum across these sites is a citywide traffic estimate.
limitations: Two October weekdays at selected delivery-peak windows; no annual/current citywide calibration.
Rider status and device type visually classified; methods acknowledge potential confusion.
Collected 15-minute intervals are not exposed individually in the released two-hour tables.
No defensible Citi Bike share or multiplier can be computed from the released categories.

reference_samples.label: Hunter College central Manhattan sample
reference_samples.share_precision: Reported to one decimal percent; exact Citi Bike numerator not published in inspected passage
reference_samples.period: April 8–May 1, 2019; 46 locations, two one-hour visits per site, 07:00–19:00 sampling range
reference_samples.limits: Stratified locations with observer exclusions and missed riders while recording; not a complete traffic census. No exact numerator reconstructed from the rounded percentage.

reference_samples.label: Basch et al. Manhattan protected lanes, bicycles
reference_samples.denominator: Citi Bike electric 17 + Citi Bike regular 301 + private electric 315 + private regular 289
reference_samples.period: Published February 2023; observation dates not reported in inspected methods
reference_samples.limits: About 100 observations per zone across ten zones; geography is not weighted by actual traffic. Different denominator choices answer different questions. Article prose contains 998/988 inconsistencies; device table sums to 988.

reference_samples.denominator: All eight Table 1 vehicle categories, including mopeds, scooters, skateboards and motorcycle/dirt bikes
reference_samples.period: Published February 2023; observation dates not reported in inspected methods
reference_samples.limits: About 100 observations per zone across ten zones; geography is not weighted by actual traffic. Different denominator choices answer different questions. Article prose contains 998/988 inconsistencies; device table sums to 988.

ui_recommendations: Offer DCP location, year and weekday/weekend selectors; show numerator, bicycle denominator, period and quality flag alongside the share.
Do not preselect a citywide multiplier from DCP or NYU. Label the historical records as local reference observations.
For a zero Citi Bike count, show the observed fraction and disable inverse scaling rather than dividing by zero.
Keep bicycle and all-micromobility denominators visibly separate for Basch and NYU.
Existing Pulaski and Basch counts are reproducible reference samples, not newly collected data. Hunter2019 is a rounded published proportion.
